spans.text: [29] AR: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ EN: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

folded.id: the heavens|and|earth and that between them in play
folded.subject: the heavens
folded.object: earth and that between them in play

spans.text: [38] AR: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ EN: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
[17] AR: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ كَرِيمٌ EN: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,

folded.id: the people|of|tubba' and those before them?
folded.subject: the people

spans.text: [37] AR: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ EN: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them?
[24] AR: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّغْرَقُونَ EN: And leave the sea in stillness.
[18] AR: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ EN: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah.
[43] AR: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ EN: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum
[39] AR: مَا خَلَقْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ EN: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
[8] AR: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ EN: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death.
[35] AR: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ EN: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
[9] AR: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ يَلْعَبُونَ EN: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
[11] AR: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ EN: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
[50] AR: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ EN: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
[14] AR: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌۭ مَّجْنُونٌ EN: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
[42] AR: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ EN: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy.
[51] AR: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍۢ EN: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place;
[52] AR: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ EN: Within gardens and springs,

folded.id: your lord|and|the lord of your first forefathers
folded.subject: your Lord
folded.object: the Lord of your first forefathers

spans.text: [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
